BiblicalUsage: The word sakkîyn means a knife (as pointed or edged). It stands in Proverbs 23:2: "…throat, if thou a man given to appetite".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe sakkîyn is in the Bible for a reason, and even one mention is enough for God.
